## The Interest-Cycling Engine: Why He Changes Hobbies

A common question for partners of ADHD specimens: *"Why did Chris spend 3 weeks obsessing over 3D printing / DnD campaigns / AI workflows, and now he hasn't touched it for a month?"*

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
THE CYCLING OPERATING SYSTEM
:::

> **Dropping a project when novelty fades is how the engine works, not a character flaw.**

* **The Reality:**  
  Chris's brain runs on interest and novelty. When a topic is fresh, he acquires deep mastery fast. When the novelty wanes, his brain pauses that tab.
* **The Secret:**  
  The interest isn't dead—it's just in sleep mode! It will re-activate when a new angle, tool, or shared challenge emerges.
* **How to Support Him:**  
  Never shame him for pausing a hobby (*"See, you never finish anything"*). Instead, celebrate the knowledge gained and welcome the next wave of creative exploration!
:::

## Travel & Expedition Mode

How Chris behaves when out in the wild on vacation:

| Behavior Dimension | Chris's Default Setting | Survival Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Airport Timing** | Strategic & Timely *(Comfortable buffer)* | Keep passports and tickets accessible. |
| **Itinerary Architecture** | **Structured Spontaneity:** Curate 2 anchor experiences per day, leave the rest open for serendipity. | Suffocates under 15-minute scheduled tour buses. |
| **Culinary Expeditions** | Passionate foodie; will walk 30 minutes for an authentic local eatery. | Never settle for a mediocre tourist trap when real flavor exists nearby. |
| **Energy Battery** | Surging explorer stamina until the 17:00 wall. | Mandatory coffee + pastry recharge stop is essential. |
